newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent down slightly in cautious dealings.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent down slightly in cautious dealings.

text.p: Brent crude futures were lower but lightly traded in late afternoon dealings on Monday, amid general nervousness over direction.
April Brent was last traded at $20.41 per barrel, down eight cents from London's settlement Friday at $20.49.
Brokers said the market tested the upside on Friday and started to come back down by late trading in London. That continued on Monday on SIMEX as a few more sellers came into the market.
Brokers said players were wary of holding long positions for too long after such sharp losses last week.
